race.comment: YOUWROTEUPONIT (10) snagged back from the wide gate third-up with a below-par eighth over 1100m at Grafton in C2 class. Nicely placed to turn things around. CERTIFIED COPY (2) is building a solid record and appreciated the class drop with a slick win first-up over 1200m at Rockhampton in fast time. Fitter for that last performance and will take catching again. TOO DARN FINESSE (13) comes here deep into the prep after scoring a gritty win with the 60.5kg over 1200m at Grafton. Sharp weight drop and she looks up to this stiffer race. Each-way. STORM MERCHANT (4) lightly raced gelding heading in the right direction. Back in grade and trip with a fighting second over 1100m at Grafton in C2 grade. A repeat performance keeps him in the mix.
